speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You may come down. The fever left you in the night. You will sit, and you will eat, and you will not tell me a play is more urgent than bread.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am down. I am well. I am not arguing with the bread.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The loaf, Mistress. It is the one from this morning.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: A finger short of the notch, and still a penny. I have said so until I am tired of the notch. Eat it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A penny, and a finger short. I will not improve the loaf by describing it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Firing is sixpence the week until Lady Day. I am not collecting it over breakfast. I am telling you, so you do not think the week was free.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Sixpence. I have it. I am not paying it onto the table between the loaf and the letter.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The letter is where you left it. Three pairs of shoes do not become smaller because you came downstairs.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I heard her. I am not writing the answer this morning. The carrier is not in again before the Thursday after Candlemas.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Shall I put the letter by his plate, Mistress, so he sees it?

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Leave it on the table where he already sees it. He is not a child, and the table is not a pulpit.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The Shrew is at two. I am not in it. Ranger's Comedy is at the Rose. I am not going to either, and I am not going as far as a posted bill to be sure of them.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then stay in. I will not have you well at breakfast and foolish by the door. Alse, his ink is upstairs. He knows the stair.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I will not move the papers. He told me yesterday they were foul, and I cannot read them anyway.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave them. I will try one line, and I will stop before I have written a bird I do not believe.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: There is ink in the horn. I did not buy it. It was there from before you were ill.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Two pence the horn when it is empty, and it is not empty. Do not make a purchase out of a morning's work.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not buy ink to feel busy. The owl is not written because I have not heard it, not because the horn is low.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then hear it upstairs, or do not. The table is finished. Your father's cough is not this house's business, and your wife's shoes are, until you answer her.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The shoes are heard. The cough is mild. The answer is not a breakfast. I have said so once, and I will not make it a grace.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Shall I bank the fire in the room, Mistress, or leave it for him?

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Leave it. A writing morning eats firing whether I like the comedy or not. Sixpence covers the week. It does not cover a speech about the week.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am going up. If I am not down at noon, I am still in the house. I am not at the Keys, and I am not at the Rose.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Stop, then. The house is ordinary again. Do not make me nurse a well man.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not. The last line is not written. That is my work, and it is upstairs, and it can wait until I have eaten.
